If the player fails and opts to QUIT the escort sequence, this is the point where he will respawn.
If the player manages to touch this trigger at any time, the full object_scanner module will complete. Enclose this entirely behind closed doors - it%27s just a failsafe in case the player manages to glitch inside the area that%27s supposed to be locked off by the scanner.
If you want to implement an %22on load pre-destroyed%22 behavior, check this on and add conditionals. At load time, if the conditionals are true, the gun acts like it%27s been previously destroyed. After load time %28during gameplay%29, this does nothing.
If you want to use this, simply check it on and have at it.

This cuts the nav mesh during the cutscene. Place this over any areas you don%27t want NPCs to wander into during the cutscene. It must be completely enclosed within the DespawnVolume, otherwise you might get characters stuck on cut nav mesh. If this isn%27t needed, uncheck it.
This defines the point that GPS draws to when driving the hacker to the terminal. Put it on the ground near the terminal at the nearest %22parking spot.%22
This has to be added to turn off the green lights even though they%27re set disabled - I believe because vehicles force enable all their children.
This is a non-hard-fail objective that precedes the first real mission objective. It completes immediately when the mission activates, triggering the first real hard fail objective %28Obj 01%29. This is a sort of a hack that is necessary since hard fails are always expected to have a non-hard-fail precursor. This is literally the only point in the game where that assumption is not true.
This is one of the rare nodes where we actually want a secret objective to instacomplete and play outro dialog at the end of node, to delay the node complete popup. We add this here because any of the three escorts could have been the last one completed. This objective starts active, and completes when all escorts are finished.
This is one of the very few hidden-dialog-objectives I%27m not removing%3B here it makes sense because the intention is to play the dialog only once, ever, the first time player has ever approached any of the scanners in the node. The objective will handily persist this fact.
This is referencing a conditionalgroup in quest_javi_intro_door.entity, in backer_25.location. The place where the in-game retract tutorial lives.
This is referencing a conditionalgroup in questaintro_main.location - the in-game booster tutorial.
This is the main hard fail objective associated with the module. Do not touch the goals or add conditionals.%0A%0AThis is a HARD FAIL OBJECTIVE. You must precede it with some other %28non hard fail%29 objective, which connects to this object via next_in_sequence_ref, and checks persistent_sequence %28not persistent_state%29. Talk to Diana or David if you are unsure how this works.
This is the point that GPS will draw to when tracking the %22go to strike%22 AOI objective.
This is to prevent random respawning of the vehicle, if it decides to despawn and later respawn due to spawn system. It won%27t try to respawn again till the module tells it to try respawning.
This is used to skip the repetitive scenes where Rico throws guns to prisoners in the soldier training grounds nodes. Resets %281%29 when the player quits and restarts the game%3B %282%29 when the player leaves and returns %28as defined by node macro dialog playing here or anywhere%29
This isn%27t really a primary spawner, as it isn%27t critical to progression and doesn%27t respawn anywhere else. Sadly adding a critical spawn %2B vehicle controller in the first objective, all just to guarantee that it is spawned before the first load screen lifts. %3A%28
This objective is used to expose an alias to be used in another location from subobjective in the escort_module.
This objective reports the state of the object%3A%0Adeactivated %3D maglocked shut.%0Aactivated %3D maglocks open, ready to be destroyed.%0Acompleted %3D destroyed.%0AUse conditionals under the objective to control clamping.%0ACheck the %22persistent_state%22 box if you%27d like to persist destruction.

To avoid bugs where you%27re just passing by the scanner while pursuing another objective, and this completes and steals tracking%3A we%27re only completing the %27reach the scanner%27 objective when the objective is tracked, or nothing else is tracked.
To use this, set reversibility to %22conditionally_reversible%22 and add conditions here. Whenever the conditions here are true, the elevator is allowed to be re-used in a toggling fashion. When it becomes false, the button will stilll remain active if it%27s currently active, but it won%27t become active again after triggering it.

we never complete this objective directly - instead the parent-parent objective %28module main objective%29 will complete when the correct vehicle is in the scanner. The reason why that logic is there is to allow for a target vehicle to be placed in the scanner at any time and complete the objective, even before the player is told to do so.
